newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc eases as mark stages correction.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc eases as mark stages correction.

text.p: 1455 GMT - The franc closed lower against the mark in a moderate correction of the mark's slide and down on the dollar, which continued to benefit most from mark weakness.

Comments from German government officials, who said there was no need to dramatise the currency situation, and somewhat more aggressive Swiss National Bank activity in the money market put a bit of pressure on mark/Swiss, Zurich dealers said.
One dealer said the mark could correct to about 82.70 centimes, but the overall downtrend remained intact.
* Dollar closes at 1.4835/4845 francs vs 1.4740/4750 * Mark finishes at 82.47/49 centimes vs 81.98/00 * Three-month eurofrancs 1.37/1.50 pct -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
